decisions.reason: As a platform-compatible sensor module that remained visible after launch, it likely meets a minimally satisfactory aspiration level and can be retained with modest slack despite some uncertainty about sustained demand.
Because it is a successor product replacing an earlier module in an established line, its performance is likely judged against a proven internal benchmark and remains satisfactory enough to keep.

The CAN bus interface fits the firm's modular electronics ecosystem and likely survives as long as it serves a stable niche, though its narrower market makes it somewhat more vulnerable if results slip below aspiration.

A dedicated CO2 sensor module is close to the firm's core capabilities and likely benefited from strong comparative demand, so management would probably continue it unless newer alternatives clearly outperform it.
